name: @k-design-probe/k-design-system-workspace

scripts.generate: node tooling/generate-tokens.mjs && node tooling/generate-icons.mjs && node tooling/generate-locales.mjs && node tooling/generate-emoji.mjs && node tooling/generate-dicebear-flutter.mjs
scripts.generate:check: node tooling/generate-tokens.mjs --check && node tooling/generate-icons.mjs --check && node tooling/generate-locales.mjs --check && node tooling/generate-emoji.mjs --check && node tooling/generate-dicebear-flutter.mjs --check
scripts.test:web-ui: node --test packages/web/ui/image-cropper.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-style.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-day-view.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-overlays.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-zone-geometry.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-zone-editor.test.mjs packages/web/ui/map-zone-working-hours.test.mjs packages/web/ui/sortable-tree.test.mjs packages/web/ui/plan-picker.test.mjs packages/web/ui/motion.test.mjs packages/web/ui/back-button.test.mjs packages/web/ui/haptics.test.mjs packages/web/ui/core-components.test.mjs packages/web/ui/sound.test.mjs packages/web/ui/menu-row.test.mjs packages/web/ui/markdown-preview.test.mjs
scripts.verify:flutter-consumer: cd examples/flutter && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && flutter build web --release
scripts.widgetbook: dart run melos exec --scope k_design_widgetbook -- "flutter run -d web-server --web-port 6007"
scripts.build:widgetbook: dart run melos exec --scope k_design_widgetbook -- "flutter build web --release" && node tooling/verify-widgetbook-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck:web: pnpm --filter @k-design-system/tokens typecheck && pnpm --filter @k-design-system/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @k-design-system/storybook typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm generate:check && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm audit:styles && pnpm check:ui-rules && pnpm build:web && pnpm test:web-ui && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm verify:web-consumer && pnpm verify:flutter-consumer && pnpm analyze:flutter && pnpm test:flutter && pnpm gate:phone-flutter && pnpm build:storybook && pnpm build:widgetbook

description: K Design System is a cross-platform component library for React/Web and Flutter. It provides shared primitives, accessible components, responsive patterns and a platform-neutral design-token source while keeping product state and business logic in the consuming application.
